james_support: Heads up — AcmeAnalytics private deployment is seeing intermittent KMS failures when calling our KMS endpoint from certain subnets. Error in app logs: `PKCS11_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE: TLS handshake failed: SNI mismatch`. Customer attached tcpdump + openssl output. Happens ~every 10-20m, only from pods in subnet 10.2.4.0/24. thread_ts 1863056789
sarah_ops: can you paste the openssl output and the pod curl? also which proxy do they route through? any TLS-inspect boxes? :thinking_face:
james_support: paste:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect kms.internal.acme:443 -servername kms.acme.corp -brief
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = proxy.inspector.corp
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Server certificate:
subject=CN = proxy.inspector.corp
``` 
shows the certificate is our TLS-inspect proxy, not the HSM cert. customer says proxy should bypass KMS host by allowlist but policy may not match. curl from pod:
```
$ curl -v https://kms.internal.acme/health
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1):
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1):
* error:1425F102:SSL routines:ssl_choose_server_version:unsupported protocol
* Closing connection 0
```

mike_infra: sounds like SNI rewritten/removed by the proxy or the proxy terminates TLS. If proxy presents its own cert then HSM will reject because CN doesn't match expected SNI. steps to repro: 1) `openssl s_client -connect <egress-proxy-ip>:443 -servername kms.acme.corp -showcerts` 2) `tcpdump -w /tmp/kms.pcap -n -s 0 port 443 and host <kms-ip>` run from the pod's node. Also check SNAT ephemeral exhaustion on the NAT box: `sudo ss -tunp | wc -l` and `cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range` and `conntrack -L | grep <pod-ip>`
dylan_dev: quick test to confirm SNI isn't forwarded: from an affected pod run
```
echo | openssl s_client -connect 10.2.5.12:443 -servername kms.acme.corp
```
if the presented cert CN != kms.acme.corp then proxy is terminating. if the certificate is the HSM cert, then issue is downstream (MTU/fragmentation or connection reset).
sarah_ops: other things to rule out: MTU fragmentation (we've seen TLS handshake fail when PMTU blocked), and iptables/transparent-proxy rewriting SNI. Try `ping -M do -s 1400 <kms-ip>` from pod to test PMTU.
mike_infra: temporary mitigation: add direct egress allowlist for KMS host to bypass TLS-inspect and SNAT via dedicated IP, schedule with netops. longer-term: fix proxy policy to passthrough SNI for `*.acme` or whitelist the kms internal CN.
oncall_rosemary: assigning to infra/networking (mike_infra) — can you take ownership? Need action plan + ETA within 2 hrs. @mike_infra
mike_infra: on it. will validate proxy policy and swap a bypass rule in staging then prod. updating in 10m.
hsm-bot: alert: HSM healthcheck missed 3/5 heartbeats (1863057410). Noting in incident queue.
james_support: customer notified of investigation; asked them to stop traffic from one failing subnet and test bypass. will report back with pcap/openssl if we need more.
